title: Sketch app that generates 3D models
author: DifficultOrchid1249
selftext:
Hello,

I'm making an AI web/iPad app that lets you sketch with a pen/tablet and generate and edit 3D models that way.

I'm looking for a few beta testers to collect feedback. LMK if you are interested and DM me. Thanks!

comments.author: ForgotMyAcc
comments.body: I’d love to try it out. Not a professional artist at all, and game dev has just been for fun, but I’m an avid sketcher of doodles. (I’m a UX designer by trade)

replies.author: DifficultOrchid1249
replies.body: Thanks for sharing. Didn't know about this. The UX looks clunky, though, which is what I want to improve on with my app.

replies.author: Rizzlord
replies.body: They will do big updates in one or two weeks, better models better textures better ui

replies.author: ai_art_is_art
replies.body:
They're fighting in a very crowded space. Meshy, Tripo, Spline, and CSM are all well-funded. Almost all of them raised over $10M.

I wish them the best, but it will not be easy.

replies.author: Katwazere
replies.body: I dare say it but it might be worth making one of these and then emailing one of the bigger companies and seeing if you can get a job in it. I know I would love to have a standalone client for tripo because I hate having to use discord chats and some server off in the world when I could license or pay a subscription for it to be local

replies.author: DifficultOrchid1249
replies.body: I'm a UX designer also, but have some game dev experience working on a game engine.  Also I like to sketch like you, that's why I made this app.

replies.author: ai_art_is_art
replies.body:
I really like your UX. You've clearly done this a lot. 

3D is crowded. Really crowded. $100s of millions in funding to lots of seed and series A stage companies. But I'm of the opinion that existing apps for this suck. You can totally win based on UX and aesthetic.

replies.author: DifficultOrchid1249
replies.body:
You get it! 

I am only saying this because I'm a very seasoned designer that all the gen AI tools out there are garbage. I particularly dislike Automattic1111 and ComfyUI, the two most popular gen AI tools out there.

They were not designed for artists or people who like to draw, you know the people that actually work on game art. So I want to make a gen AI tool for artists and people like me.

It's a custom canvas drawing app with at threejs model viewer, I designed everything except the color picker =P (you have to thank Apple for that one ;))

comments.author: Born_Arm_6187
comments.body: nice, it is the first public tool that do exactly this?

replies.author: DifficultOrchid1249
replies.body: There are plenty of 3D modeling AI apps out there. But this UX of making it feels like a sketch book is novel, and I have not seen anything else like it out there.

comments.author: Niar666
comments.body:
Welp, I have to go watch the Shelter music video again.

Seriously though, this sounds awesome!
